updateLog.en:
[Improved] Local and WebDAV mounts can coexist
Related operations can be performed in Me > Settings > Audio Source Settings
[Improved] Multi-column support for artists and albums
[New] Native support for APE format
[New] Predictive back support (only supported on some systems)
[New] Flyme status bar lyrics support (only supported on Flyme)
[Optimized] Smoother support for 16 KB page size
[Beautified] Redesigned some menus for better aesthetics
[Fixed] Issue where covers or artists are duplicated in some scenarios
[Fixed] Issue where shuffle play and single-track loop do not work
[Fixed] Issue where some Android 17 devices have no sound in the background
[Fixed] Issue where Android 6.0 cannot read the media library
